dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Voices climb the ridge. I needed one that wouldn’t.

dialogue.speaker: Ronin
dialogue.text: [A rising trill and a short chirp.]

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: The old beacons. One has been calling this valley by a name it had before the sky burned.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Until a bearing goes. Beyond the rim, the Salt Steps trade copper and bearings for seeds and sailcloth. Take what we can grow.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Keep flying. It learned mine before I was born.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: You understand. The village is counting on us.
